name: mini-galaxy-pv-v2
description: One-contract-per-event proxy voting on Polygon Amoy with Neon indexing, a Render relayer, Vercel UI, and dApp-triggered MetaMask Snap communications.

scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:shared
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run build:web && npm run build:snap
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,INDEXER,WEB "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:indexer" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run check:structure && npm run test && npm run build:web && npm run build:snap
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace @pv/contracts && rm -rf apps/web/dist apps/snap/dist
